title: RDW–MCV interaction fails an incremental cross-cycle HbA1c prediction test beyond flexible individual blood-cell measures
abstract: A fixed source-standardized RDW-by-MCV product was tested in 1892 source and 2397 independent-cycle NHANES adults without reported diagnosed or treated diabetes. Target weighted MSE changed by -0.00001241 percentage-points squared (conditional95% interval [-0.0005010797831197456, 0.000547347579562326]; source/target refit interval [-0.0007397662352115953, 0.0039495457941256485]). The 0.0087% point gain did not meet the fixed uncertainty or 1% descriptive criteria. Source cross-validation and several sensitivities worsened. This does not refute known cell-index associations or establish equivalence.
